title: The Scale of Perfection
author: Walter Hilton
description: Walter Hilton’s medieval guide to the contemplative life discusses self-knowledge, prayer and the reformation of the soul. Evelyn Underhill edited this edition.
editionNote: 1923 edition. London: John M. Watkins. Edition credit: ed. Evelyn Underhill (1875–1941).
rights: Public-domain historical edition. Source credit and notices are retained.
